settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about Beautican — from ingredients to shipping.

settings.question: How long does shipping and delivery take?
settings.answer:
Within Riyadh: Same-day delivery when ordered before 12 PM noon.
Within Saudi Arabia: 1 to 5 business days.
International shipping: 7 to 15 business days.

settings.question: Is the product licensed and certified?
settings.answer: Yes. Beautican is a dietary supplement fully approved by the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA).

settings.question: Is the product Halal certified?
settings.answer: Yes. The product holds an official certified Halal certification.

settings.question: What type of collagen is used?
settings.answer: Beautican uses Peptan B — bovine hydrolyzed collagen peptides known for their high bioavailability and maximum absorption rate.

settings.question: What are the ingredients?
settings.answer:
Each sachet contains:
• Hydrolyzed Collagen (Peptan B) — 3,000 mg
• Biotin — 5,000 mcg
• Vitamin C — 150 mg

All ingredients comply with European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) regulations.

settings.question: Where is Beautican manufactured?
settings.answer: Beautican is proudly formulated and manufactured in Italy under strict European pharmaceutical standards.

settings.question: What are the main benefits?
settings.answer:
• Improved skin elasticity and hydration
• Stronger hair and nails
• Joint flexibility and cartilage support
• Enhanced with Vitamin C for maximum collagen synthesis

settings.question: How do I use Beautican?
settings.answer: Take one sachet daily, dissolved in water. It can be taken at any time of day, with or without food.

settings.question: Can it be taken on an empty stomach?
settings.answer: Yes. Beautican can be taken on an empty stomach without any issues.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Results vary from person to person. Most customers notice initial improvements within 4–8 weeks of consistent daily use. For optimal results, a 2–3 month course is recommended.

settings.question: Does collagen affect body weight?
settings.answer: No. Collagen is a low-calorie supplement and does not directly cause weight gain or weight loss.

settings.question: Is Beautican suitable for people with diabetes?
settings.answer: Beautican is sugar-free. However, we always recommend consulting your doctor before starting any new supplement if you have a pre-existing medical condition.

settings.question: Is it safe during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
settings.answer: We recommend consulting your doctor before using any dietary supplement during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

settings.question: Is Beautican suitable for both men and women?
settings.answer: Yes. Beautican is designed for adults of all genders who want to support their skin, hair, nails, and joint health.

settings.question: Are there any side effects?
settings.answer: No common side effects have been reported when Beautican is used at the recommended dosage. If you experience any unusual reactions, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional.

settings.question: Does collagen raise bad cholesterol (LDL)?
settings.answer: No. Collagen is a safe protein that does not cause an increase in LDL (bad) cholesterol when used at recommended dosages. If you have existing cholesterol concerns, we recommend speaking with your doctor.

settings.question: Is Beautican suitable for teenagers?
settings.answer: Beautican is intended for adults aged 18 and above. Use by minors is not recommended without prior consultation with a healthcare provider.
